description_en: Modifies SMS signatures that have failed the review or have been approved. After the modification, an autocommit is performed to commit the signature for review, and the signature enters the pending review state
description_zh: 修改未通过审核和已经审核通过的签名，修改完成后自动提交审核，签名进入待审核状态
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi update-sms-sign --sign-name '阿里云验证码' --qualification-id 856300 --sign-source 2 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmsSign

parameters.help_en: The SMS signature that has not passed the review. You can view the SMS signatures that failed the review on the Domestic Message > Signature Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) tab in the console. You can also call the [QuerySmsSignList](~~QuerySmsSignList~~) API operation to view the SMS signatures that failed the review
parameters.help_zh: 未审核通过的短信签名。您可在控制台国内消息>签名管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)页签进行查看未通过审核得短信签名。也可通过[QuerySmsSignList](~~QuerySmsSignList~~)接口查看未通过审核的短信签名
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The scenario description of the SMS signature. This is one of the reference information for signature review. The length cannot exceed 200 characters.
You can provide the usage scenarios of launched services and provide website links or app store download links for the actual services.
You can provide a complete SMS example to reflect your business scenarios.
You can provide the parameter passing content of variables to describe the business usage scenarios and the reasons for selecting the variable attributes in detail.
If the signature involves government or enterprise institutions, add a remark with the landline phone number of the institution.

A complete application description improves the review efficiency of signatures and templates. If the description is not filled out according to the specifications or is left blank, the signature review may be affected
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名场景说明，是签名审核的参考信息之一，长度不超过200个字符。
您可以提供已上线业务的使用场景，并提供实际业务的网站链接、应用市场下载链接等。
您可以提供短信完整示例，体现您的业务场景。
您可以提供变量的传参内容，详细描述业务使用场景和选择这个变量属性的原因。
若签名涉及政企机关单位，请备注政企机关单位的固定电话。

信息完善的申请说明会提高签名、模板的审核效率。如未按规范进行填写或不填写，可能会影响您签名审核的通过
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The signature type. Valid values:

0: Verification code.
1: General (default).

Use the default value: General
parameters.help_zh:
签名类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：通用（默认值）。

建议使用默认值：通用
parameters.name: sign_type

parameters.help_en: The additional materials. Upload supplementary business proof documents or business screenshots to help reviewers understand your business details. For more information, see [Signature application materials](~~108076#section-xup-k46-yi4~~) and upload the relevant materials
parameters.help_zh: 更多资料。补充上传业务证明文件或业务截图，有助于审核人员了解您的业务详情。请参见[签名申请材料](~~108076#section-xup-k46-yi4~~)，上传相关材料
parameters.name: more_data

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approved qualification.

Before applying for an SMS signature, apply for a qualification (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/user-guide/new-qualification).
You can view the qualification ID on the Qualification Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/qualification) page
parameters.help_zh:
已审核通过的资质ID。

在申请短信签名前，请先申请资质 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/user-guide/new-qualification?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.718d187bbkpMRK)。
您可在资质管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/qualification)页面查看资质ID
parameters.name: qualification_id

parameters.help_en: The app store link. If the signature source is "Launched App", which means the SignSource parameter is set to 2, enter an app store link that starts with http:// or https:// and make sure that the app is launched
parameters.help_zh: App应用商店链接，若签名来源为“已上线APP”，即`SignSource`取值为2时，请填写http://或https://开头的应用商店链接，并确保App已经上线
parameters.name: apply_scene_content

parameters.help_en:
The signature source. Valid values:

0: The full name or abbreviation of an enterprise or institution. (Recommended)
5: The full name or abbreviation of a trademark.
2: The full name or abbreviation of an app. (Not recommended)

For detailed descriptions of signature sources, see [Signature sources](~~108076#section-fow-bfu-wo9~~)
parameters.help_zh:
签名来源。取值：

0：企事业单位的全称或简称。（优先推荐）
5：商标名的全称或简称。
2：App应用的全称或简称。（不推荐）

签名来源的详细说明请参见[签名来源](~~108076#section-fow-bfu-wo9~~)
parameters.name: sign_source

parameters.help_en:
The signature usage. Valid values:

false: Self-use (default). The signature is the enterprise, website, or product name that has passed the real-name verification of the current account.

true: Third-party use. The signature is an enterprise, website, or product name that has not passed the real-name verification of the current account.
<notice>If the signature is for self-use, select a self-use qualification ID. If the signature is for third-party use, select a third-party use qualification ID.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
签名用途。取值：

false：自用（默认值，签名为本账号实名认证的企业、网站、产品名等）。

true：他用（签名为非本账号实名认证的企业、网站、产品名等）。
<notice>签名为自用时，请选择自用资质ID；签名为他用时，请选择他用资质ID。></notice>
parameters.name: third_party

parameters.help_en: The ID of the letter of authorization. If the signature is for third-party use, the ID of the letter of authorization cannot be empty. Otherwise, the signature review fails. The unified social credit code in the letter of authorization must be consistent with the unified social credit code field in the qualification information bound to the signature. Otherwise, the signature creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 委托授权书ID，当签名为他用时，委托授权书ID不可为空，否则签名审核不通过。委托授权书的社会统一信用代码必须与签名绑定的资质信息中社会统一信用代码字段保持一致，否则创建签名失败
parameters.name: authorization_letter_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the trademark entity.
If SignSource is set to 5, you must pass the trademark entity ID.
You can obtain the trademark entity ID by calling the [CreateSmsTrademark](~~CreateSmsTrademark~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh:
商标实体id。
当SignSource=5时，需要传商标实体id。
商标实体id可以通过调用[创建商标实体](~~CreateSmsTrademark~~)接口获取
parameters.name: trademark_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the app ICP filing entity.
If SignSource is set to 2, you must pass the ICP filing entity ID.
You can obtain the ICP filing entity ID by calling the [CreateSmsAppIcpRecord](~~CreateSmsAppIcpRecord~~) API operation
parameters.help_zh:
APP-ICP备案实体id。
当SignSource=2时，需要传备案实体id。
备案实体id可以通过调用[创建ICP备案实体](~~CreateSmsAppIcpRecord~~)接口获取
parameters.name: app_icp_record_id

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request. Valid values:

OK: The request is successful.
Other error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

OrderId.description_en:
The ticket ID.

Reviewers use this parameter when querying the review. You must provide this ticket ID when you need to expedite the review
OrderId.description_zh:
工单号。

审核人员查询审核时会用到此参数。您需要审核加急时需要提供此工单号

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
